duplicate_avoidance.rule: Do not duplicate the parallel decoy-mapping experiment or Hostinger ProductStart work. This receipt records only the independently observed same-inode content-stability race, its repair, exact-head test and merge.

observed_reality.baseline_attestor: runtime/frank_storage_truth_v1/frank_sqlite_live_process_attestor_v1.py sampled mapped path/device/inode before and after a pathname hash but did not bind the hash to one FD or fence in-place content mutation metadata.

latest_generic_vps_receipt.implication: Generic self-hosted success is not accepted Hostinger production evidence.

external_primary_evidence.finding: The WAL-reset corruption defect affects releases through 3.51.2 under the documented concurrent writer/checkpoint conditions and is fixed in 3.51.3+.
Upstream 3.53.4 is on the fixed line; version strings alone do not prove Frank's exact productive mapped runtime.

grf.anchor_R0: The live-process attestor bound path/device/inode around hashing but the library file can be root-owned and writable by deployment/root operations.
grf.generated_reality_R2: Stable mapped device+inode may be treated as sufficient content identity during the hash window.
grf.counter_reality_R3: An in-place rewrite can preserve device+inode+size while changing bytes during attestation, so those identity fields alone do not prove content stability.
grf.discriminating_test: Modify a disposable root-owned 0644 SQLite-shaped file in place during a slow hash while recording device/inode/size/mtime/ctime and before/after hashes.

go_out_of_box.name: SQLITE_SAME_INODE_CONTENT_MUTATION_DURING_HASH
go_out_of_box.scope: Disposable local /tmp file only; no Frank/VPS/provider/Harness/canonical runtime mutation.

mechanism: Hash the expected mapped library through one O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC read-only FD.
Bind that FD's fstat device+inode to the selected /proc/<pid>/maps identity before hashing.
Fence device, inode, size, mtime_ns and ctime_ns across the same-FD hash.
Require the pre-hash pathname stat snapshot to equal the FD snapshot.
Retain pre/post PID-generation and mapping checks.

fusion.hypothesis: Binding the hash to the mapped inode plus content-stability metadata closes the observed accidental/deployment same-inode rewrite race for the attestation window.
fusion.strongest_counterhypothesis: This remains local observation integrity, not malicious-root remote attestation, and can be irrelevant to release if the observed PID is not the accepted productive Frank service.

reentry.next_falsifier: On the accepted Hostinger target bind owner-pinned host + systemd unit + executable + root SQLite anchor to the selected live Frank service PID, exercise productive UnifiedDB persistence, then prove restart and rollback/downgrade/library-swap rejection in one provenance-bound receipt.
reentry.forbidden_promotion: Do not promote generic self-hosted runner success, mapped-library mechanism success, or a SQLite version string to productive Frank release acceptance.
